title: Show HN: I was tired of opening 2 tabs for every HN link, so I made a userscript
summary: A browser userscript that enhances Hacker News by displaying article content alongside HN comments in a resizable side panel, eliminating the need to switch between multiple tabs when reading articles and discussions.
problem_solved: Removes the friction of constantly switching between separate tabs for reading Hacker News article content and the associated comment discussions.
why_valuable: Improves reading workflow by consolidating article consumption and discussion engagement into a single unified browser view, saving time and context-switching overhead.
